OK, I was commissioned to do a soundtrack through an associate producer named Kenny Inaoka in Japan with this filmmaker and photographer Tadayuki Naitoh. He was an award winning, well-known photographer in Japan, but he’s an artistic photographer. He went off to Africa and he got really turned on by the patterns of zebras. So he spent a long time there filming zebras. Shooting stills and video footage of them. He wanted a soundtrack for this video. It was a forty-minute video. He showed me the photos of the…
What type of drum machine did you use?
